brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.
A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.
A herb planter of three cells side by side, each with a bin that drains.
A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.
A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.
A small display stand: three bases meeting at a corner with a raised platform on a spike at that corner.
A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.
Three bases joined at a corner, standing on a stud spike that faces down under that corner.
A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.
Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.
A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.
A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.
